campaign.scope: W128/W256/W128/W256,26000/s,350000 arrivals,Q64. Both sides have the same new node/load artifact and maxSessions256. modeContext.scope: Runner count is a configuration expectation: DEDICATED includes sender, receiver, conductor and native-resource runners. Observed TIDs/CPU are retained under raw kernel-truncated comm names; no name is expanded into an invented role.

arrivalWindow.scope: Load-generator UTC origin is approximate; wall clocks are not verified synchronized. Only interior adjacent samples are differenced; monotonic time determines every rate. A lack of samples is unavailable, never a zero-CPU/zero-drop claim.

cgroupQuotaAndThrottling.scope: Current visible cgroup leaf, shared with sampler and other processes; node2 also contains the load JVM. CPU usage and throttling counters are joined only across adjacent whole-collection-interior samples with the same version/path/quota. Nanosecond counters remain nanoseconds; cpuPeriods/throttledPeriods are counts. Missing/reset counters remain unavailable, never zero. Visible quota is an upper bound, not dedicated cores; hidden ancestors and physical host contention are not measured. Aggregate spare quota does not establish spare capacity in any one thread.

observer.scope: Mean per-sample collector process CPU cost divided by configured cadence, not an observer-off comparison. Per-collection cost excludes JSON serialization/flush and idle; the complete observer's total CPU includes other phases. Ratio to load CPU uses independently sampled local aggregate telemetry intervals and is approximate.

threads.scope: CPU joins require identical process identity and TID/startTicks; new/disappeared threads contribute no guessed CPU. Thread-name groups can combine many instances and kernel-truncated names. schedstat/wchan only cover the collector's selected top16 threads; wchan=0 can mean running or unavailable, and zero schedstat can mean disabled instrumentation. This does not identify a unique causal bottleneck.

udpSockets.scope: Only verified owned PID sockets with fd/inode ownership rechecked by the collector. Adjacent joins require identical process/family/inode/localbind and an overlapping fd set. Newly observed counters are not counted as arrival-window drops. Disappearance is observed absence, not a certified close; gaps, races and fd caps can hide sockets. Queue gauges are kernel-accounting bytes, not packets or effective SO_RCVBUF capacity. Drops are observed socket drop-counter increments, not business-command losses or proof of the unique loss mechanism; resets/wraps are excluded.

recorderCounters.samplingScope: CapacityCounters records timestamp after the counter scan; samplingNanos spans the scan and timestamp construction. Conservatively require timestamp-samplingNanos >= arrival start and timestamp <= arrival end. The frozen helper then differences first/last identical counter registrations over elapsedNanos, which is local monotonic time at scan start. This cumulative-counter coverage may span missed interior observations, unlike adjacent-pair thread/socket CPU coverage. Counter values and position differences are non-atomic; no exact lag or physical disk service-time inference. Archive type107 is cumulative wall time in the write path including write+force+descheduling; it is not pure fsync latency.
recorderCounters.scope: Only unchanged counter id + registration id + type + label identities are differenced; missing/reused registrations are not assumed zero. Positions identified by label/type and log stream 100. Follower receive-HWM is distinct from leader append position. Position differences are signed non-atomic observations, not exact lag or fsync durability proof.

loadSummary.latencyScope: Conditional on returned response; accepted-only distribution is separate. All offered accepted-command p99 is null if any arrival is dropped, rejected, errored or unresolved.
limitations: Fixed finite window and bounded queues; queue-full is client admission loss, not server rejection
Each worker has one in-flight synchronous client; this measures this deployed client+cluster path, not an unconstrained engine limit
No synchronized-clock one-way latency and no production capacity SLA
Execute-start is an API timestamp, not first wire offer; scheduler delay and FIFO delay are included in end-to-end latency
Backlog counters are observational non-atomic snapshots, not exact queue conservation at an instant
Pause gateway/projector writers and use isolated trial state; shared-member load generation must be disclosed
loadSummary.percentileMethod: nearest rank; all returned replies retained including responses after timeout/drain; not-sent and unresolved are counted separately, not given invented latency

recorderCounters.samplingScope: CapacityCounters records timestamp after the counter scan; samplingNanos spans the scan and timestamp construction. Conservatively require timestamp-samplingNanos >= arrival start and timestamp <= arrival end. The frozen helper then differences first/last identical counter registrations over elapsedNanos, which is local monotonic time at scan start. This cumulative-counter coverage may span missed interior observations, unlike adjacent-pair thread/socket CPU coverage. Counter values and position differences are non-atomic; no exact lag or physical disk service-time inference. Archive type107 is cumulative wall time in the write path including write+force+descheduling; it is not pure fsync latency.
recorderCounters.scope: Only unchanged counter id + registration id + type + label identities are differenced; missing/reused registrations are not assumed zero. Positions identified by label/type and log stream 100. Follower receive-HWM is distinct from leader append position. Position differences are signed non-atomic observations, not exact lag or fsync durability proof.

failureAdapter.source:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,hashlib,datetime
root=Path("evidence/2026-10-23/runpod-optimization/window350k")
def module(name,path):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);return m
window=module("failure_window",root/"tool-validation/summarize-window-attribution.py")
core=module("failure_core",root.parent/"tool-validation/summarize-attribution.py")
thread=module("failure_thread",root.parent/"threading/tool-validation/summarize-threading-attribution.py")
net=module("failure_net",root.parent/"network/tool-validation/summarize-network-attribution.py")
helper=module("failure_cnc",Path("scripts/summarize-capacity-telemetry.py"))
r=window.summarize(root,("w128","w256"))
d=root/"w256/runs/w-window-26000-w256-r1"
load=core.read_json(d/"load-result.json",r["inputs"]);failure=core.read_json(d/"failure.json",r["inputs"])
manifest=core.read_json(d/"trial.json",r["inputs"]);receipt=core.read_json(d/"receipt.json",r["inputs"])
assert manifest.get("completedAt") and receipt["exitCode"]!=0
start=core.utc(load["scheduledOriginUtcApproximate"]);end=start+load["arrivalWindowSeconds"]
paths=[d/f"node{n}-attribution.jsonl" for n in range(3)]
for p in paths:
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert rows[-1].get("type")=="complete",str(p)
leader=core.read_json(d/"fixed-leader-check.json",r["inputs"])
config=core.read_json(d/"configuration.json",r["inputs"])
trial={"id":d.name,"manifest":manifest,"retainedFailedTrial":True,
 "validationPassed":False,"capacityEligibility":"CORRECTNESS_FAILED_NOT_A_VALID_CAPACITY_POINT",
 "failure":failure,"receipt":receipt,"fixedLeaderCheckPassed":leader.get("passed"),
 "arrivalWindow":{"scheduledOriginUtcApproximate":load["scheduledOriginUtcApproximate"],"arrivalWindowSeconds":load["arrivalWindowSeconds"],"scope":"Approximate UTC origin; only whole-collection-interior adjacent monotonic samples. A failed canonical/per-reply validation is retained as a failure, not converted into accepted throughput."},
 "clientReportedLoadOutcomes":{k:load.get(k) for k in ("workers","scheduledArrivals","queueCapacityPerWorker","confirmedAcceptedCommands","confirmedWithinArrivalWindow","unknownAtInitialDeadline","unresolvedFinal","clientNotSentCommands","completionWindowSeconds","drainSeconds")},
 "observerFileCount":3,"observers":[core.observer_summary(p,d/p.name.replace("-attribution.jsonl","-telemetry.jsonl"),start,end,r["inputs"],1.5) for p in paths],
 "cgroupQuotaAndThrottling":[thread.cgroup_summary(d/f"node{n}-telemetry.jsonl",start,end,core,helper,r["inputs"]) for n in range(3)],
 "recorderCounters":[net.recorder_summary(d/f"node{n}-counters.jsonl",start,end,core,helper,r["inputs"]) for n in range(3)],
 "outsideWindowSocketBufferAttestation":{stage:net.buffer_attestation(d/f"socket-buffer-{stage}.json",core,r["inputs"]) for stage in ("before","after")},
 "observerCapCoverage":[window.observer_limits(p,start,end,core,r["inputs"]) for p in paths],
 "csvArchiveEvidence":window.csv_archives(d,r["inputs"]),
 "workerAndRetentionContext":{"workers":256,"queueCapacityPerWorker":load["queueCapacityPerWorker"],"totalConfiguredFifoSlots":256*load["queueCapacityPerWorker"],"declaredCoreLimits":config.get("expectedCoreLimits"),"declaredResultCachePerProducer":config.get("expectedResultCachePerProducer")}}
campaign=core.read_json(root/"w256/campaign.json",r["inputs"])
r["cohorts"]["w256"]={"completedLoadResultTrials":1,"failedTrials":1,"campaign":campaign,"trials":[trial]}
r["pendingOrUnavailableTrials"]=[x for x in r["pendingOrUnavailableTrials"] if x["id"]!=d.name]
r["unavailableCohorts"]=[x for x in r["unavailableCohorts"] if x["cohort"]!="w256"]
for data in r["cohorts"].values():
 for t in data["trials"]:
  td=root/("w256" if t.get("retainedFailedTrial") else "w128")/"runs"/t["id"]
  if not t.get("retainedFailedTrial"):
   result=core.read_json(td/"result.json",r["inputs"])
   t["capacityEligibility"]="CANONICAL_VALID_BUT_CLASSIFICATION_SEPARATE"
   t["clientReportedLoadOutcomes"]={k:result.get(k) for k in ("workers","scheduledArrivals","confirmedAcceptedCommands","confirmedWithinArrivalWindow","unknownAtInitialDeadline","unresolvedFinal","clientNotSentCommands")}
r["test"]="failed-W256-vs-overloaded-W128-attribution"
r["scope"]="Exactly two actually completed first trials. W256 per-reply correctness failed; reported confirmations are client classifications, not validated business outcomes. No repeated/4-point capacity claim. Pilot remains separately saved and no full replicated checkpoint/restart is asserted. Frozen modules are read-only; this failure adapter calls their public selection/CPU/socket/CnC/cgroup functions without creating a fake result.json."
r["failureAdapter"]={"source":globals().get("ADAPTER_SOURCE"),"scope":"Frozen generic core requires final result.json and omitted the failure. This adapter retains failure.json+nonzero receipt+three completed observers, labels correctness false, and uses identical observation functions. It does not modify or rerun the frozen verifier/analyzer."}
r["generatedAt"]=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
out=root/"analysis/failed-window-attribution-summary.json"
r["failureAdapter"]["reproductionArgv"]=["python3","-B","-c","import json; from pathlib import Path; r=json.loads(Path("+repr(str(out))+").read_text()); s=r['failureAdapter']['source']; exec(s,{'ADAPTER_SOURCE':s})"]
out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"output":str(out),"trials":{k:len(v["trials"]) for k,v in r["cohorts"].items()},"failedCorrectness":1,"pending":len(r["pendingOrUnavailableTrials"])}))
